name: pi-vista
description: Model-agnostic execution augmentation and experience system for Pi

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/core && npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/adapter-workspace-guard && npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/cli && npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/checks
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace=@pi-vista/core && npm run test --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm run test --workspace=@pi-vista/adapter-workspace-guard && npm run test --workspace=@pi-vista/cli && npm run test --workspace=@pi-vista/checks
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-vista/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-vista/adapter-workspace-guard && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-vista/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-vista/checks
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@pi-vista/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@pi-vista/adapter-workspace-guard && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@pi-vista/cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@pi-vista/checks
